title: Unit Summative — Cumulative Assessment (Days 1-29)
topic: Cumulative review across geometry (area), percent, ratios/rates, expressions/equations, and rational numbers/coordinate plane

items.prompt: A parallelogram has a base of 12 units and a height of 7 units. Find its area.
A parallelogram has a base of 6 units, a height of 5 units, and a slanted side of 8 units. What is its area?

misconception_key.B: used the slanted side instead of the perpendicular height (third measurement point for the representation study, following d8_q4 and d9_q3)
misconception_key.C: added base + height instead of multiplying
misconception_key.D: used only one dimension (base) and ignored height

items.rationale: Area = base x height = 6 x 5 = 30. This is the third measurement point (Day 8 -> Day 9 -> Day 30) for tracking whether this misconception is fading over the unit.

items.prompt: An $80 jacket is discounted 25%. What is the sale price?
A juice-to-water ratio of 2:7 is scaled by a factor of 4. What is the new second number (water)?
A car travels 180 miles on 6 gallons of gas. What is the unit rate in miles per gallon?
Write an inequality for "a number x is more than 9."
items.rationale: "More than 9" means strictly greater than: x > 9.

items.prompt: The point (-3, -6) lies in which quadrant?
items.rationale: Negative x, negative y places a point in Quadrant III.
